senses.en: Fine-grained rock formed from hardened mud.

ex.en: Dinosaur tracks were preserved in mudstone.
ex.zh: 恐龙足迹保存在泥岩中。

senses.en: Rock made of sharp broken fragments cemented together.

ex.en: Breccia forms near faults and craters.
ex.zh: 角砾岩形成于断层和陨石坑附近。

senses.en: operated by compressed air or filled with air

ex.en: Workers used a pneumatic drill to break the pavement.
ex.zh: 工人用风钻凿开路面。

ex.en: Pneumatic systems are widely used in manufacturing because compressed air can power tools safely and efficiently.
ex.zh: 气动系统广泛用于制造业，因为压缩空气能安全高效地驱动工具。

tip: 词首p不发音；常指靠压缩空气驱动的设备。

senses.en: Dark gray rock that splits into thin flat pieces.

ex.en: The roof was covered with slate tiles.
ex.zh: 屋顶铺着石板瓦。

senses.en: Very hard rock formed from sandstone under heat and pressure.

ex.en: Quartzite resists weathering.
ex.zh: 石英岩耐风化。

senses.en: Metamorphic rock that splits into thin, shiny layers.

ex.en: Mica flakes make schist sparkle.
ex.zh: 云母片使片岩闪闪发光。

senses.en: Metamorphic rock with light and dark bands.

ex.en: Some of the oldest rocks on Earth are gneiss.
ex.zh: 地球上最古老的一些岩石是片麻岩。

senses.en: The most common group of minerals in the earth's crust.

ex.en: Feldspar weathers into clay.
ex.zh: 长石风化成黏土。

senses.en: A sudden confused mental state, often caused by illness.
A state of extreme excitement or happiness.

ex.en: During his fever, he slipped into delirium and spoke incoherently.
ex.zh: 发烧期间，他陷入谵妄状态，说话语无伦次。

ex.en: Hospital staff need appropriate training to recognise delirium promptly, particularly among older patients recovering from surgery.
ex.zh: 医院工作人员需要接受适当培训，以及时识别谵妄，尤其是术后恢复中的老年患者出现的谵妄。

col: a state of delirium｜谵妄状态
tip: 医学义是急性意识混乱，不等于长期痴呆。

senses.en: A mineral that splits into thin, shiny, transparent sheets.

ex.en: Mica was once used in stove windows.
ex.zh: 云母曾被用于炉窗。

senses.en: A common mineral made of calcium carbonate.

ex.en: Limestone is made mostly of calcite.
ex.zh: 石灰岩主要由方解石构成。

senses.en: A soft white mineral used to make plaster.

ex.en: Gypsum forms when salty water evaporates.
ex.zh: 咸水蒸发时会形成石膏。

senses.en: The mineral form of common salt.

ex.en: Thick beds of halite lie beneath the desert.
ex.zh: 沙漠下方有厚厚的岩盐层。

senses.en: Made of crystals; very clear.

ex.en: Granite has a crystalline structure.
ex.zh: 花岗岩具有结晶结构。

senses.en: A regular repeated pattern, as of atoms in a crystal or crossed strips.

ex.en: Atoms in salt form a cubic lattice.
ex.zh: 盐中的原子构成立方晶格。

senses.en: Having a long-established habit that is unlikely to change.

ex.en: My uncle is an inveterate collector of old maps.
ex.zh: 我叔叔收藏旧地图成癖。

ex.en: Inveterate car users may resist public transport initiatives unless services become substantially more convenient and reliable.
ex.zh: 除非服务变得便捷可靠得多，否则长期习惯开车的人可能会抵触推广公共交通的举措。

col: inveterate traveller｜常年热衷旅行的人
tip: 通常置于名词前，强调长期习惯难以改变。

senses.en: The way a mineral splits along flat surfaces; a division.

ex.en: Mica has perfect cleavage in one direction.
ex.zh: 云母在一个方向上有完全解理。

senses.en: The way a surface shines when light falls on it.

ex.en: Gold has a metallic luster.
ex.zh: 金子有金属光泽。

senses.en: A layer of rock; a level of society.

ex.en: Each stratum represents a different period.
ex.zh: 每个地层代表不同的时期。

senses.en: The study of rock layers and their order.

ex.en: Stratigraphy helps date fossils.
ex.zh: 地层学有助于确定化石的年代。

senses.en: Solid rock beneath soil; the basic principles on which something rests.

ex.en: The building's foundations rest on bedrock.
ex.zh: 建筑地基坐落在基岩上。

senses.en: a form of an element with a different number of neutrons

ex.en: Carbon has several isotopes.
ex.zh: 碳有几种同位素。

ex.en: By measuring how much of a radioactive carbon isotope remains in bones, scientists can estimate how old they are.
ex.zh: 通过测量骨头中放射性碳同位素的剩余量，科学家能估计其年代。

tip: 放射性碳定年法 radiocarbon dating 的关键概念。

senses.en: An arch-shaped fold in rock layers.

ex.en: Oil often collects in an anticline.
ex.zh: 石油常聚集在背斜中。

senses.en: A trough-shaped fold in rock layers.

ex.en: The valley follows a syncline.
ex.zh: 这条山谷沿着一个向斜延伸。

senses.en: The gradual sinking of land.

ex.en: Pumping groundwater caused subsidence.
ex.zh: 抽取地下水导致地面沉降。

senses.en: The laying down of sediment by water, wind or ice; removing someone from power.

ex.en: Deposition at the river mouth built a delta.
ex.zh: 河口的沉积形成了三角洲。

senses.en: Sand, silt and clay left by flowing water.

ex.en: Fertile alluvium covers the valley floor.
ex.zh: 肥沃的冲积土覆盖着谷底。

senses.en: Able to be defended or maintained against criticism.

ex.en: His excuse was no longer tenable after we checked.
ex.zh: 我们核实后，他的借口就再也站不住脚了。

ex.en: The assumption that economic growth always improves public wellbeing is no longer tenable in every context.
ex.zh: 经济增长总能改善公众福祉这一假设，已不能在所有情境下成立。

col: a tenable position｜站得住脚的立场
a tenable argument｜经得起推敲的论点
no longer tenable｜不再站得住脚
tip: 常形容论点或立场站得住脚，不等于舒适。

senses.en: A bend in a river; to follow a winding course.

ex.en: The river meanders across the plain.
ex.zh: 河流蜿蜒流过平原。

senses.en: A U-shaped bend in a river, or a lake formed when it is cut off.

ex.en: An oxbow lake formed after the flood.
ex.zh: 洪水过后形成了一个牛轭湖。

senses.en: Flat land next to a river that floods regularly.

ex.en: Farms on the floodplain have rich soil.
ex.zh: 河漫滩上的农场土壤肥沃。

senses.en: A raised bank built along a river to prevent flooding.

ex.en: The levee broke during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨中堤坝决口了。

senses.en: The place where two rivers meet; a coming together.

ex.en: The city stands at the confluence of two rivers.
ex.zh: 这座城市位于两河交汇处。

senses.en: To hold someone or something firmly.
A small fastening that holds something closed.
A firm hold with the hands or arms.

ex.en: She clasped my hand as we crossed the bridge.
ex.zh: 过桥时，她紧紧握住我的手。

ex.en: Young children may clasp a familiar toy during medical appointments because it provides comfort in unfamiliar surroundings.
ex.zh: 幼儿就诊时可能会紧抱熟悉的玩具，因为它能在陌生环境中带来安慰。

col: clasp someone's hand｜紧握某人的手
clasp your hands together｜双手紧握
tip: clasp作动词强调握紧；作名词也可指首饰搭扣。

senses.en: A deep, narrow valley with steep sides.

ex.en: A stream runs through the ravine.
ex.zh: 一条小溪流过峡谷。

senses.en: Relating to glaciers or ice ages; very cold or slow.

ex.en: Glacial ice carved the valley.
ex.zh: 冰川冰雕刻出了这条山谷。

senses.en: The covering of land by glaciers, or the effects of it.

ex.en: Repeated glaciation shaped the Great Lakes.
ex.zh: 反复的冰川作用塑造了五大湖。

senses.en: A ridge of rocks and soil left by a glacier.

ex.en: The moraine marks where the glacier ended.
ex.zh: 冰碛标志着冰川的尽头。

senses.en: A long oval hill shaped by a glacier.

ex.en: Drumlins point in the direction the ice moved.
ex.zh: 鼓丘指向冰川移动的方向。

senses.en: A peaceful, happy experience, especially in the countryside.
A poem or short story describing peaceful country life.

ex.en: Our summer idyll ended when the noisy builders arrived.
ex.zh: 吵闹的建筑工人一来，我们宁静美好的夏日生活便结束了。

ex.en: The rural idyll portrayed in tourism campaigns often overlooks the economic difficulties faced by farming communities.
ex.zh: 旅游宣传中描绘的田园乐境往往忽视了农业社区面临的经济困难。

tip: 既可指田园诗，也常指田园般的恬静生活。

senses.en: A long winding ridge of sand and gravel left by a stream under a glacier.

ex.en: The road follows the top of an esker.
ex.zh: 公路沿着蛇形丘的顶部延伸。

senses.en: A bowl-shaped hollow carved by a glacier on a mountain.

ex.en: A small lake fills the cirque.
ex.zh: 一个小湖填满了冰斗。

senses.en: A long narrow inlet of the sea between high cliffs.

ex.en: Norway is famous for its fjords.
ex.zh: 挪威以峡湾闻名。

senses.en: A deep crack in a glacier.

ex.en: The climber fell into a crevasse.
ex.zh: 登山者掉进了冰隙。

senses.en: Fine yellow soil deposited by wind.

ex.en: The Loess Plateau is covered with wind-blown dust.
ex.zh: 黄土高原覆盖着风吹来的尘土。

senses.en: Sounding sad, especially in a gentle or complaining way.

ex.en: A plaintive cry came from the kitten outside our door.
ex.zh: 门外的小猫发出了一声哀怨的叫声。

ex.en: The musician uses a plaintive melody to convey the loneliness experienced by people living far from home.
ex.zh: 这位音乐家用哀伤的旋律表达远离家乡的人所感受到的孤独。

tip: 多形容声音、语调或旋律中流露的哀伤。

senses.en: A hill of sand formed by the wind.

ex.en: Sand dunes move slowly across the desert.
ex.zh: 沙丘在沙漠中缓慢移动。

senses.en: A crescent-shaped sand dune.

ex.en: Barchans form where wind blows from one direction.
ex.zh: 新月形沙丘形成于风向单一的地方。

senses.en: A flat-topped hill with steep sides.

ex.en: The mesa rises above the desert floor.
ex.zh: 台地高耸于沙漠地面之上。

senses.en: An isolated hill with steep sides and a flat top, smaller than a mesa.

ex.en: Monument Valley is famous for its buttes.
ex.zh: 纪念碑谷以孤丘闻名。

senses.en: A long steep slope at the edge of a plateau.

ex.en: The road climbs the escarpment in sharp turns.
ex.zh: 公路沿着陡坡急转弯向上爬。

senses.en: Capable of forming ideas or mental images.

ex.en: The philosopher described imagination as a conceptive faculty.
ex.zh: 这位哲学家把想象力描述为一种形成心中构想的能力。

ex.en: In older philosophical writing, the conceptive faculty enables people to form ideas beyond their immediate sensory experience.
ex.zh: 在较早的哲学著作中，构想能力使人能够形成超出当下感官经验的观念。

tip: 罕见词；勿与表示“概念上的”conceptual混用。

senses.en: A landscape of limestone with caves and sinkholes formed by dissolving water.

ex.en: Guilin's karst hills attract many visitors.
ex.zh: 桂林的喀斯特山峰吸引了许多游客。

senses.en: A hole in the ground formed when rock below dissolves and collapses.

ex.en: A sinkhole swallowed a car.
ex.zh: 一个天坑吞没了一辆车。

senses.en: A column of mineral hanging from a cave ceiling.

ex.en: Stalactites grow only a few centimeters a century.
ex.zh: 钟乳石每个世纪只生长几厘米。

senses.en: A column of mineral rising from a cave floor.

ex.en: A stalagmite met a stalactite to form a pillar.
ex.zh: 石笋与钟乳石相连形成石柱。

senses.en: Describing a well where water rises by natural pressure.

ex.en: Artesian water flows without pumping.
ex.zh: 自流水无需抽取就能流出。

senses.en: to formally inform someone about something

ex.en: Please apprise me of any changes before Friday.
ex.zh: 如有任何变化，请在周五前告知我。

ex.en: Schools should apprise parents of significant policy changes before introducing new rules that affect their children.
ex.zh: 学校在推行影响孩子的新规定之前，应告知家长重大的政策变化。

col: apprise someone of something｜将某事告知某人
keep someone apprised｜随时向某人通报
tip: 正式用语；用apprise sb of sth，勿混appraise。

senses.en: A thick layer of ice covering a large area of land.

ex.en: The Greenland ice-sheet is melting faster.
ex.zh: 格陵兰冰盖正在加速融化。

senses.en: The process of forming mountains by folding and lifting of the earth's crust.

ex.en: The Himalayan orogeny is still going on.
ex.zh: 喜马拉雅造山运动仍在进行。

senses.en: Relating to the formation of mountains.

ex.en: Orogenic belts form where continents collide.
ex.zh: 造山带形成于大陆碰撞处。

senses.en: The balance of the earth's crust floating on the denser mantle.

ex.en: Isostasy explains why land rises after ice melts.
ex.zh: 地壳均衡解释了冰融化后陆地为何上升。

senses.en: Relating to the balance of the crust on the mantle.

ex.en: Scandinavia is still experiencing isostatic rebound.
ex.zh: 斯堪的纳维亚仍在经历均衡回弹。

senses.en: To a very great degree, especially in a positive way.

ex.en: Your spare room looks eminently suitable for a study.
ex.zh: 你那间空房看起来非常适合用作书房。

ex.en: Improving insulation is an eminently sensible way to reduce household energy consumption and heating costs.
ex.zh: 改善隔热保温是降低家庭能耗和取暖费用的非常明智的方法。

tip: 常修饰褒义形容词；勿与imminently（即将）混淆。

senses.en: The single supercontinent that existed about 300 million years ago.

ex.en: Pangaea began to break apart in the Jurassic.
ex.zh: 泛大陆在侏罗纪开始分裂。

senses.en: An ancient southern supercontinent.

ex.en: India was once part of Gondwana.
ex.zh: 印度曾是冈瓦纳大陆的一部分。

senses.en: A huge landmass made of several continents joined together.

ex.en: Supercontinents form and break up over hundreds of millions of years.
ex.zh: 超大陆在数亿年间聚合又分裂。

senses.en: Magnetism preserved in ancient rocks, showing past positions of the poles.

ex.en: Paleomagnetism supported the theory of continental drift.
ex.zh: 古地磁学支持了大陆漂移学说。

senses.en: The ground at the bottom of the sea.

ex.en: New seafloor forms at mid-ocean ridges.
ex.zh: 新的海底在洋中脊形成。

senses.en: An ancient practice seeking to turn ordinary metals into gold
A mysterious process that transforms ordinary things into something special

ex.en: The exhibition explored alchemy through old jars and furnaces.
ex.zh: 展览通过古老的罐子和熔炉来介绍炼金术。

ex.en: Although alchemy lacked a modern scientific framework, its experimental techniques contributed to the development of chemistry.
ex.zh: 虽然炼金术缺乏现代科学框架，但其实验技术推动了化学的发展。

col: the alchemy of creativity｜创造力的神奇转化作用
tip: 通常不可数；比喻义强调神奇转化，并非泛指魔法。

senses.en: Relating to the deepest parts of the ocean.

ex.en: Abyssal plains are among the flattest places on Earth.
ex.zh: 深海平原是地球上最平坦的地方之一。

senses.en: An underwater mountain that does not reach the surface.

ex.en: Fish gather around the seamount.
ex.zh: 鱼群聚集在海山周围。

senses.en: A flat-topped underwater mountain.

ex.en: A guyot was once an island worn flat by waves.
ex.zh: 平顶海山曾是被海浪削平的岛屿。

senses.en: A ring-shaped coral island surrounding a lagoon.

ex.en: Darwin explained how atolls form.
ex.zh: 达尔文解释了环礁的形成。

senses.en: An area of shallow seawater separated from the sea by sand or coral.

ex.en: The calm lagoon is perfect for swimming.
ex.zh: 平静的潟湖很适合游泳。

senses.en: Deep respect and admiration for someone or something.

ex.en: She handled her grandmother's old violin with quiet reverence.
ex.zh: 她怀着深深的敬意，轻轻拿起祖母的旧小提琴。

ex.en: Reverence for traditional craftsmanship can encourage communities to preserve skills that might otherwise disappear.
ex.zh: 对传统工艺的崇敬能促使社区保留那些可能失传的技艺。

tip: 通常不可数；对某人的崇敬用reverence for。

senses.en: A long ridge of sand in a river or the sea.

ex.en: The boat got stuck on a sandbar.
ex.zh: 船搁浅在沙洲上。

senses.en: A sand ridge connecting an island to the mainland.

ex.en: At low tide you can walk across the tombolo.
ex.zh: 退潮时可以走过连岛沙洲。

senses.en: A narrow piece of high land sticking out into the sea.

ex.en: A lighthouse stands on the headland.
ex.zh: 一座灯塔矗立在岬角上。

senses.en: A small curved bay.

ex.en: Smugglers once hid in the cove.
ex.zh: 走私者曾躲在小海湾里。

senses.en: A narrow strip of land joining two larger areas.

ex.en: The Isthmus of Panama joins two continents.
ex.zh: 巴拿马地峡连接两个大陆。

senses.en: the rigid outer layer of the earth

ex.en: The lithosphere includes the crust.
ex.zh: 岩石圈包括地壳。

ex.en: The lithosphere is broken into tectonic plates that float on the softer layer of rock beneath.
ex.zh: 岩石圈分裂成若干构造板块，漂浮在下方较软的岩层上。

senses.en: A very small island.

ex.en: Seabirds nest on the rocky islet.
ex.zh: 海鸟在岩石小岛上筑巢。

senses.en: A shallow area in water; a large group of fish.

ex.en: Ships avoid the dangerous shoals.
ex.zh: 船只避开危险的浅滩。

senses.en: Relating to the area between high and low tide.

ex.en: Intertidal creatures survive both air and water.
ex.zh: 潮间带生物能在空气和水中生存。

senses.en: Moving along the shore.

ex.en: Longshore drift moves sand along the beach.
ex.zh: 沿岸漂移使沙沿海滩移动。

senses.en: Relating to the shore of a sea or lake.

ex.en: The littoral zone is rich in life.
ex.zh: 沿岸带生物丰富。

senses.en: A viral illness causing painful swelling near the jaw

ex.en: The doctor checked her swollen cheeks for signs of mumps.
ex.zh: 医生检查了她肿胀的脸颊，判断是否有腮腺炎的迹象。

ex.en: Routine vaccination helps prevent mumps and reduces the likelihood of outbreaks in schools and other crowded settings.
ex.zh: 常规接种疫苗有助于预防腮腺炎，并降低学校及其他人员密集场所暴发疫情的可能性。

tip: 虽以s结尾，但作疾病名称用单数：mumps is。

senses.en: Relating to an estuary.

ex.en: Estuarine waters mix salt and fresh water.
ex.zh: 河口水域咸淡水交汇。

senses.en: The settling of particles to the bottom of a liquid or body of water.

ex.en: Sedimentation slowly fills lakes.
ex.zh: 沉积作用慢慢填满湖泊。

senses.en: The process by which sediment turns into rock.

ex.en: Lithification takes millions of years.
ex.zh: 岩化作用需要数百万年。

senses.en: Pressing something so that it becomes denser.

ex.en: Compaction squeezes water out of sediment.
ex.zh: 压实作用把水从沉积物中挤出。

senses.en: The binding of sediment grains by minerals.

ex.en: Cementation glues sand grains into sandstone.
ex.zh: 胶结作用把沙粒粘成砂岩。

senses.en: The physical and chemical changes in sediment after it is deposited.

ex.en: Diagenesis can alter fossils.
ex.zh: 成岩作用可能改变化石。

senses.zh: 温文尔雅的；善于应酬的
senses.en: Polite, confident, and comfortable in social situations.

ex.en: Our urbane host welcomed everyone with a warm smile.
ex.zh: 我们温文尔雅的主人面带温暖的微笑欢迎每一位客人。

ex.en: An urbane manner can help diplomats build trust, although successful negotiations also require substantial expertise.
ex.zh: 温文尔雅的举止能帮助外交官建立信任，不过成功的谈判也需要扎实的专业知识。

tip: urbane指人文雅善交际；urban指城市的。

senses.en: The process of becoming a fossil.

ex.en: Fossilization requires rapid burial.
ex.zh: 化石形成需要迅速掩埋。

senses.en: Turning organic material into stone.

ex.en: Petrification preserved the tree's rings.
ex.zh: 石化作用保留了树木的年轮。

senses.en: Turned into stone; extremely frightened.

ex.en: The petrified forest is millions of years old.
ex.zh: 这片石化林有数百万年历史。

senses.en: Containing fossils.

ex.en: Fossiliferous limestone is full of shells.
ex.zh: 含化石的石灰岩里满是贝壳。

senses.en: Relating to measuring age using radioactive decay.

ex.en: Radiometric dating shows the rock is 4 billion years old.
ex.zh: 放射性测年显示这块岩石有40亿年历史。
